feeling: Relieved first, actually relieved — it said not bitter, not petty, and it said the 'because you could' line is honest, which is the line I was most scared of. Then kind of cornered by the 'so what is it for' part. Like I got asked a question and then had it answered for me. And there's this one line, 'nothing at all, which might sting in its own way,' that I skimmed past and then went back to and now I'm a bit annoyed and I don't totally know at what. Tired. It's late.
body: Phone too close to my face, in bed, lamp still on. Shoulders dropped when I read 'not bitter or petty' — I scrolled back up and read that paragraph twice. Then jaw tight through the middle section. Stomach did a small drop at 'nothing at all.' I'm picking at the corner of the phone case with my thumbnail. Keep flipping back to the draft and then back to the reply.
private_thoughts:
ok. ok good. it's not petty. it read the mom thing and didn't flinch and didn't say i was making too much of it. it said 'you're telling someone they hurt you' like that's just a normal true sentence. fine. fine.

but then 'what is the message for.' like i know what it's for. it's so he knows. and then it goes ahead and tells me what the honest answer is, in quotes, like it's reading my diary. 'get the thought out of our body' — oh come on. priya would've said 'just send it' and been done and instead i've got this thing telling me the sending is a separate decision. which. i mean. yeah. that's literally what i've been doing for two weeks, deciding it's separate, over and over.

the 'most people would reply' part. i've thought about him replying. i've had the whole fight in my head like nine times. what i haven't really — the nothing one. because that's the actual sam version. that's the one where he reads it, maybe screenshots it to marc, and just doesn't. and that's — it doesn't even matter, that's not why i'm sending it.

the 'it wasn't even funny' note is fair. it's a jab. i knew it was a jab, i just liked it. it wasn't funny though. cutting it feels like letting him off on the one small mean thing i allowed myself.
pushing_away: someone who saw it and never said anything. like — no. that's a different thing. that's not the same as — anyway. also if he doesn't answer that's just him being him, i'm not going to be checking my phone for a week like some — no. it's fine. it's not why.

costs.item: Admitting how much it actually hurt

message:
ok the 'it wasn't even funny' note is fair, I'll take it out. it wasn't funny though lol.

I guess I don't totally get the 'what is it for' thing. it's so he knows. I'm not expecting him to write back, honestly I'd be kind of surprised if he did, he never really took any of this seriously when we were together so I don't know why he'd start now. I just don't want to be someone who saw all that and never said anything. does that make sense or is that the same thing you were saying
